children: Calisa Acquisition entered into a Prepaid Forward Purchase Agreement with Goodvision AI and funds managed by Harraden Circle Investments to help retain cash through its pending merger with Goodvision. The Purchaser may buy up to 3,000,000 Calisa ordinary shares at no more than the redemption price (about $10.31 per share as of Aug 31, 2026). At or promptly after closing, Calisa will pay the Purchaser a prepayment equal to the purchased shares times the redemption price and reimburse related expenses, and the purchased shares will not be voted. Unsold shares may be returned 12 months post-closing, and pricing may reset under certain conditions.
